limits: One extra natural interpretation on three minimum-demo episodes of the accepted largest_component mode. Fits use demonstrations only; rejected rivals never inspect query labels. No full battery, source repair, accepted-source rebuild, or admission decision.

programs.area:
(rule! (lambda (g)

    (define (complete-corners scene)
      (for/fold ([out scene]) ([color (in-list (grid-colors scene 0))])
        (define cells (find-color scene color))
        (if (>= (length cells) 2)
            (let ([bb (bbox-of-cells cells)])
              (paint-cells out
                (positions-in-rect (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))
                color))
            out)))
    (define (first-largest groups)
      (for/fold ([best '()]) ([cells (in-list groups)])
        (if (> (length cells) (length best)) cells best)))
    (define (keep-component scene cells)
      (grid-from-fn (rows scene) (cols scene)
        (lambda (r c)
          (if (member (list r c) cells) (at scene r c) 0))))

    (let ([completed (complete-corners g)])
      (keep-component completed
        (first-largest (components-any-nonzero completed))))
))
programs.perimeter:
(rule! (lambda (g)

    (define (complete-corners scene)
      (for/fold ([out scene]) ([color (in-list (grid-colors scene 0))])
        (define cells (find-color scene color))
        (if (>= (length cells) 2)
            (let ([bb (bbox-of-cells cells)])
              (paint-cells out
                (positions-in-rect (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))
                color))
            out)))
    (define (first-largest groups)
      (for/fold ([best '()]) ([cells (in-list groups)])
        (if (> (length cells) (length best)) cells best)))
    (define (keep-component scene cells)
      (grid-from-fn (rows scene) (cols scene)
        (lambda (r c)
          (if (member (list r c) cells) (at scene r c) 0))))

    (define (edge-perimeter cells)
      (for/sum ([p (in-list cells)])
        (for/sum ([d (in-list (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))])
          (if (member (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))) cells) 0 1))))
    (let* ([completed (complete-corners g)]
           [groups (components-any-nonzero completed)]
           [selected (for/fold ([best '()]) ([cells (in-list groups)])
                       (if (> (edge-perimeter cells) (edge-perimeter best)) cells best))])
      (keep-component completed selected))
))
